{
  "name": "repowise",
  "displayName": "Repowise",
  "description": "Codebase intelligence for Claude Code. Indexes your codebase into five layers (Graph, Git, Docs, Decisions, Code Health) and exposes them through task-shaped MCP tools, so Claude understands architecture, ownership, hotspots, why code is built the way it is, and where the defect risk lives.",
  "version": "0.55.0",
  "author": {
    "name": "Repowise",
    "email": "hello@repowise.dev",
    "url": "https://repowise.dev"
  },
  "homepage": "https://repowise.dev",
  "repository": "https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise",
  "license": "AGPL-3.0",
  "icon": "./.claude-plugin/icon.png",
  "documentationUrl": "https://docs.repowise.dev",
  "supportUrl": "https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/issues",
  "privacyPolicyUrl": "https://repowise.dev/legal/privacy",
  "termsOfServiceUrl": "https://repowise.dev/legal/terms",
  "userConfig": {
    "lens_margin": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Lens margin notes",
      "description": "Under an Edit or Write, show the governing decision or recent fix history the Repowise hook flagged for that file.",
      "default": true
    },
    "lens_squeeze": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Lens squeeze rows",
      "description": "Under a Bash result that repowise distill shortened, show the lines before and after and the command that restores the rest.",
      "default": true
    },
    "lens_review": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Lens change review",
      "description": "After a turn that edits files, review the working tree with get_change_risk and show the result beneath Claude's answer.",
      "default": true
    },
    "lens_flow": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Lens Flow tab",
      "description": "Show a dashboard of each turn in the /lens pane's Flow tab: what an edit reaches that Claude did not look at, the files it worked from, what filled its context, and what Repowise answered.",
      "default": true
    },
    "lens_pane_autoopen": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Open the Lens map on the first read",
      "description": "Opens the Lens map pane when Claude first reads a file, if the terminal is wide enough to place it without asking. /lens opens it at any time.",
      "default": false
    },
    "lens_map_health": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Lens map health colours",
      "description": "Colours the Lens map's tiles by code health from the start. Off, the map is quiet tiles that light up with the files Claude touches; the Health colours button in the map turns the bands on at any time.",
      "default": false
    }
  },
  "keywords": [
    "codebase",
    "code-intelligence",
    "documentation",
    "architecture",
    "code-health",
    "mcp",
    "graph",
    "git"
  ]
}
